front.title: 1 Timothy
front.theme: FROM DUST TO THE LIFE THAT IS TRULY LIFE

paragraphs: Most men read 1 Timothy as a manual for church leaders. But before Paul gives one charge, he tells what happened to him: a blasphemer and a persecutor obtained mercy, and the grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly.
Twelve weeks walk the letter from the good law to the life that is truly life — men who pray, leaders above reproach, and God revealed in the flesh.
items: The full passage in the World English Bible
Five Greek word studies, each with a Live It response
Five Life Application practices and a daily prayer
A Bottom Line and a “Lift Up Your Eyes” benediction
